newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Wilmar said raised to buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Wilmar said raised to buy.

text.p: -- PaineWebber raised its rating of Wilmar Industries Inc to buy on Thursday, according to a source at the brokerage.
-- The stock had been rated attractive when PaineWebber initiated coverage of the company in August.
-- Wilmar distributes maintenance and repair supplies to the apartment housing markets.
-- Analyst Todd Berko was not immediately available for comment.
